== Notes ==
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* One attack will trigger your Riposte, Deadly Riposte, and Auspicious Parry/[[Gladiator's Defense]] if you have all active.

== Trivia ==
* A [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riposte riposte] is an offensive action with the intent of hitting one's opponent, made by the fencer who has just parried an attack. The [[skill icon]] shows the correct position of a riposte.
